entries.rationale: No second kernel or physics implementation is introduced; cases target the canonical SWAP5 kernel/runtime seam.
Catalog contains no I/O implementation and does not move file parsing into the kernel.
Case metadata distinguishes forcing, physical state, diagnostics and numerical/reference policy.
No persistent state layout is changed.
No worker scratch ownership is changed.
No storage layout is changed; bounded catalog cases do not prescribe object-per-column solver ownership.
Restart interaction explicitly requires committed-state transaction semantics and rejects trial leakage.
Restart/equivalence case requires physical restart from committed state; no trial state is promoted to physics.
All cases are defined over bounded generic intervals/events, never a required calendar day.
No coupling-window duration is hard-coded; TB09 does not qualify MODFLOW coupling.
Coupling is not weakened or duplicated; direct coupling remains outside this catalog workunit.
No TB09 case is presented as direct groundwater coupling evidence; direct H/q contract remains untouched.
Every water-bearing case has an explicit hard water ledger; no soft conservation tradeoff is admitted.
No interface-sensitivity contract is changed.
No production coupling run-count policy is changed.
Cases are single-column interaction qualifications reusable by MultiSWAP; no per-column heavy solver architecture is introduced.
No MODFLOW cell/tile mapping is introduced.
Bottom flux is not relabeled as deep recharge; deep-vadose composition remains external.
Any future transfer component must appear explicitly in the mass ledger; TB09 does not implement transitions.
Full Richards is a qualified reference class, not a hard architectural lock to one solver.
Existing admitted crop, ET, drainage and forcing owner evidence is reused rather than cloned.
Catalog references process contracts/evidence, not HeadCalc internal arrays.
Physical process coverage and execution profiles/reference policy are separate metadata.
Cases are bounded and a DEEP reference case records nonlinear cost diagnostics; no fallback physics change is admitted.
A Full Richards O4 reference-oriented DEEP case is retained; physics admission requires pinned reference evidence.
Every case declares expected diagnostics including a hard mass residual.
Optional crop and soil-temperature dimensions appear only in cases that explicitly activate them.
No system composition, area fractions or deep-vadose routing is moved into SWAP.
Forcing intervals, boundaries and time transitions are explicit; no midnight/file/MODFLOW dependency is assumed.
This invariant audit and validator make invariant traceability part of TB09 admission.
